page.overview:
Who is Babysitting Lady?

The Babysitting Lady is a woman who works at Rubber Baby Buggy Bumpers Babysitting Service as a receptionist. When Marge calls her to get a babysitter for her children, she says that the Simpsons are banned. Homer "Sampson" then calls up and hires a babysitter.

She does not seem to be very intelligent, first questioning Homer if his wife called, but buys his story when he says "Sampson, not Simpson". She also acts very superior, then talking about the Simpsons behind their backs about how they are "a bunch of savages".

She was one of the people who found out that Michael Jackson was coming to Springfield in Stark Raving Dad.

She later appears in Lisa's dream in Treehouse of Horror II.
